articles.title: Feeling nervous? Work that system to calm it down
articles.snippet: Scientists are exploring new ways to regain control of stressed-out nervous systems, including humming, tapping on the skin and cooling the face.
articles.summary: Scientists are exploring new ways to calm stressed-out nervous systems, such as humming, tapping on the skin, and cooling the face. These methods help people regain control when they are feeling nervous.

articles.title: Scientists Say: Sanguivore
articles.snippet: Blood-drinkers evolved tricks for making use of this widespread but tricky-to-digest food source.
articles.summary: Blood-drinkers evolved special tricks to help them digest this tricky food source. Animals that drink blood use these adaptations to make use of it.

articles.title: Your skin’s chemistry may affect which mosquitoes you attract
articles.snippet: Three species picked their favorite human targets based on skin odor and bacteria. The findings could lead to the design of better repellents.
